recipient.description: The UUID of the wire recipient for wires sent using this template.

source_account.description: The UUID of the source account for wires sent using this template.

name.description: Name of the wire template for easy reference in the UI. This name must be unique to all templates owned by an organization.

wire_reason.description: Choices are configurable via Institution Settings. Please refer to Institution Settings for the most current list of wire reason types. If not provided, this value must be included when making a request to send a wire.

amount.description: A field that returns the original value in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. cents). If not provided, this value must be included when making a request to send a wire.

memo.description: Memo for wires sent using this template. If not provided, this value must be included when making a request to send a wire.
